name: adv_diag_no_mangled_scalar_in_message
source:
// A residual failure inside a component: the diagnostic must name the
// COMPONENT and quote its source line, never a mangled `f1$p` scalar.
Source SRC(f1, fluid$ = Water, mdot = 2.0, P = 100000, T = 320)
Valve  VA(f1, f2, Cv = 0.01, rho = -980, u = 1, model$ = fixed)
Sink   SK(f2)
f2.P = 500000
m = f2.mdot

error.message: There are 11 equations and 10 variables. The problem is overspecified and cannot be solved. Redundant relation (no free variable left to determine): f2.P=500000. A common cause: the same physics stated twice — a boundary pinning a quantity a component already defines (a re-equated mixer pressure, a T-pinned wall state), or two property calls restating one relation.
